Art-directed natural understated elegance, lonely dreamlike stillness, broad diffuse light, no glitter, no metallic shine, no rainbow coating, no hard highlights, no texture lines, no surrounding halo. Show a three-quarter view, complete silhouette with generous empty margin on a flat medium charcoal gray background. Exactly one bubble, no fish, no scenery, no other bubbles, no text, no cast shadow, no ground.

Use the supplied painting only for its restrained poetic underwater mood, sparse movement and muted cream and pale-cyan palette.
